sources.title: Jonathan B. Berk, Campbell R. Harvey and David Hirshleifer, Preparing a Referee Report: Guidelines and Perspectives
sources.actual_version: February17,2015 on actual physical/printed1. Seven pages; PDF modification metadata in2016 is not its stated authorship date. This is not the related2017 JEP article.
sources.inspection_attribution: Inherited original inspection recorded in canonical V13C12 sources; that record does not name the individual inspector. C11 author read the retained record, not a fresh primary-body or page-image inspection.
sources.inherited_reading: All seven physical/printed pages read in official web text; local text retained. Used role and scope2, summary/cover letter/report3, supported major versus optional comments4–5, proportionality/evidence and avoiding endless requests6–7.
sources.supports: A referee’s concise contribution summary, evidence for consequential objections, distinction between required repair and optional extension, and proportionate follow-up.
limits: Authors’ dated methodological guidance is not a current binding journal policy. Do not inherit prestige thresholds, rejection-rate assertions, a one-counterexample-only convention or automatic rejection from a correctable error.
The teaching rubric assesses validity and relevance without claiming actual publication quality, external human certification, or a predetermined policy view.
sources.current_use: Only supported major criticism, necessary repair versus optional extension, and proportionate response. Full 2015 guidance is distinct from C04 reuse of the 2017 JEP bibliographic record.
